body: Register row B-36 (docs/tasks/AUDIT-BUILT-2026-11-05.md): the one-way mirror of likes and playlists into the music server (docs/04 section 3, the promise to people who keep another Subsonic app, ticked in docs/27) lives only in this task's text; the board title says 'each phone gets its own key'. navidrome.py has no star or playlist call. Give the mirror its own title, or move it to P3-11 (use a music server you already run), or take the promise out of docs/04 and docs/27.
